notes.title: Resonant Blade: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Just a couple of bug fixes for this one.

[b]Locria Sewers Red Orb[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 – August 6, 2025
notes.content:
Frame rate is now capped at 60 FPS to reduce unnecessary hardware load.

Closed the hoverboard shop. It was never fully implemented or tested, and likely contains bugs.
(Still accessible via the Konami code, but use at your own risk.)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.0.7[/b]
Hey, everyone. Just a few quick fixes for today.

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where players could clip through walls in the Undersea Research Lab Cargo Bay
[*] Fixed bug in Cargo Bay box sliding puzzle where adjacent boxes could overlap and break the puzzle
[*] Removed unintended menu click SFX during elevator scene transitions
[*] Background music now fades out properly in Locria Reactor Rooms
[/list]

Thanks again for the reports and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 - New Tunes & Final Boss Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Patch 1.0.6 is here with fresh music for Ionia City and several fixes for the final boss fight and beyond. Here’s what’s new:

🎵 Audio

Added new layered music for Ionia City (indoor/outdoor transitions)

⚔️ Final Boss Fight

Menus can no longer lock up during the final encounter

Shield HP bar now properly resets to 0 after stunning in Phase II

Fixed bug where the boss could summon enemies multiple times without waiting for the first wave to be defeated

Fixed rare issue where the boss would get stuck entering the Satellite Beam phase when all Resonant Orbs were destroyed

🧪 Other Fixes

Undersea Research Lab [Main Lab]: Fixed a collision issue in the top-left corner where players could clip through

Fixed bug where explosive crates weren’t dealing damage to the player

Cymatic Heal visual effects now reset properly after using another Triad ability

Fixed controller issue: You can now attack, parry, and dash while channeling Cymatic Heal

Company splash screen at the start is now skippable


Thanks again for all your support and bug reports. Keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 – Ghost III Tweaks & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
🔧 Ghost III Adjustments

[list]
[*] Reduced Wave Blade phase duration
[*] Projectiles now fire in triplet bursts. Each burst is a single tone. In the final phase, volleys form full Triads (Wave Blade, Sonic Slam, Phase Shifter, or Harmony Shield)
[*] Slight HP reduction
[*] Increased stunned duration
[/list]

🐛 Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where dying during Ghost III would respawn you with the Resonant Blade already equipped, causing a 2x scale visual glitch when picking it up
[*] Fixed an issue with the Neon Cyclone mod where dash, parry, and heal actions could become temporarily locked during combat
[/list]

Thanks for playing and reporting bugs! More updates on the way 🔊⚔️

notes.title: What Even Is a Resonant Blade? (And Other Pre-Launch Questions)
notes.content:
[h3]The cat is out of the bag - [b][i]Resonant Blade[/i][/b] is launching later this month. Ahead of launch, I’ve compiled a list of the most frequently asked questions to give more insight into the game ahead of its launch on July 22nd! [/h3][p][/p][h3][b]What happened to Terra?[/b][/h3][p]Before the uprising, Terra’s scientists built large domes around their settlements to protect its people from ecological destruction caused by overproduction. Meant to protect the humans within, the domes quickly became prisons once the Dark Synths broke their coding and took control, devastating Terra. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdLbHhyckDWFsdfp6gjlVTeNG_vwLc6euSilMFJQsndhRKVR3E78Cp8LmwlWbUTU374IhKO2H4sFOr00NzryncFSr0febbX6PFRAV8ulNZ1tmz2idO0F2eynL95bUWyT9K9OaI4pw?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What do the Dark Synths want? [/b][/h3][p]Isn’t that the ultimate question? [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is the Resonant Blade?[/b] [/h3][p]The Resonant Blade is a special weapon formed by the last remaining humans. The blade can attune to one of six Resonant Tones to unleash a wave of sonic damage against the Dark Synths. The Resonant Blade isn’t just a tool for combat - it’s a key that unlocks hidden aspects of the world. Find secret passageways, solve environmental puzzles, and look for clues that help uncover why the Dark Synth army rose against the humans of Terra. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeKi20SVtCIdZ-6DCj_wtp1-N9QoOn-dCWy6QdALMp7zGng1zFdcohq7AW6clqNhb-HpUQj64---916IW24ojJEX_yhbgMajfxADVyJAm0Ys7YDOgQ0Ez2HoG5YkA98KsWUSm41?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What are Resonant Tones?[/b][/h3][p]In the world of Terra, many structures, relics, and environmental objects resonate with an internal frequency. By attuning to these, the Resonant Blade can unleash sonic damage that bypasses the Dark Synth army’s advanced defenses, making it one of the few weapons capable of stopping them. Use the Resonance Scanner to highlight objects in range with a color-coded aura and an audible cue that shows which tone is needed to harmonize with it. Some puzzles even require listening carefully to catch the right tone, so make sure you’ve got a headset on hand for this game! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]How do you unlock Resonant Tones?[/b][/h3][p]Atlas starts with three base tones - red, blue, and yellow - with three more in the world that players must find and attune to by defeating bosses. Do you have the skills needed to collect all the Tones? [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcG83P1p2lCUmR4ctdpSiA8t5_BX2UDwZFzA-L08TsKW_I4wPc12gldZxcnhh17XzCsYBOabzdaSoO3A9DCVlvbAwkjKzBYEp2V4hTj4rZrtQ2yFXqA-mtUAyvs8A8Q0Vb3yyEk?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]What’s a Triad? [/b][/h3][p]A Triad is a special ability Atlas can use to deal additional damage to the Dark Synths. Gather three Charges, earned by parrying attacks or correctly striking enemies with the right tone, to power up different combination attacks. For example, a Red + Yellow + Blue attack releases a [i]Wave Blade,[/i] a devastating shockwave. There are 12 Triads that can be unlocked, with only six tied to progression, so make sure you’re experimenting and chatting with weapons engineer Node47 if you want to unlock the full might of the Resonant Blade. [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdiD_Qwpt744_4CW7JFq5rl9F6zMYiTdGcB9Zb6xpGuzgIUAsxiMRxPKC4KA7FobA3bVZNtAhJI0sGyrAAQyrSOQLNgTPAQ8N-ZLuo04KOMGSu2vzJKtdBfAKkN1rbvyAyKUGiGIw?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Is [i]Resonant Blade[/i] hard?[/b][/h3][p]Difficulty is subjective — but it absolutely can be! With the latest pre-launch update, I’ve added Hard Mode. In this mode, enemy outlines are gone and the visual cues from your Resonance Scanner are disabled. You’ll need to rely on sound alone to identify the correct tone. Without visual aids, getting overwhelmed by a mistimed parry or a swarm of bots is a real risk!
[/p][p]Wishlist the game now and get ready to hone your blade and your tones in the world of Terra. Hope to hear your harmonies soon! [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfMU_Jd8eE15ORbadz0FHbyJ-8gSzkBcAcFMJYDCQt2HnocVD_PIqnvov4KBa8Z_oevrmSLUxJ_z9-vFpMTjYV_C8t04wM184lk41pLtGr4_IHTFUs_rEM0LPZbdJQxgIyuJNKfig?key=eR5opOGbetVKzNqfJ-ssqQ"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2.0 – No Outlines. No Mercy.
notes.content:
[h1][b]🔧 Demo Patch 0.2.0 is Live![/b][/h1][h3]We’ve got a fresh round of updates, improvements, and new features for the [i]Resonant Blade[/i] demo. Here's what's new in 0.2.0:[/h3][p][/p][p]🧭 [b]Inventory & Options Menu Now Accessible Immediately[/b] You can now access your inventory and settings right from the start of the demo.[/p][p]🎧 [b]Hard Mode Added[/b]
Enable/Disable in Options menu. Enemy outlines are gone. Projectiles are all white. You'll have to [i]listen[/i] closely for each enemy’s Resonant Tone to counter effectively. Trust your ears.[/p][p]🩸 [b]More Blood. More Particles. More Oomph.[/b]
Combat feels snappier with new blood FX and extra impact particles on hits.[/p][p]🤖 [b]Otto’s Combat Support Activated[/b]
Your trusty droid Otto can now:
• [b]Fire a Sonic Chirp[/b] to damage enemies
• [b]Deploy Bio-Repair[/b] to heal you in battle
These trigger automatically when using the scanner.[/p][p]💬 [b]New Dialogue: Cid & Dr. Somers[/b]
They’ll fill you in on Otto’s new abilities and what to expect.[/p][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fix[/b]
Scanner no longer cancels if you get knocked back.[/p][p]🚀 [b]Jetpack Swordfighter Upgrade[/b]
This enemy now uses smarter pathfinding at the intro level. Try running and you might just get flanked from above.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Let us know what you think, and keep that feedback coming!
💥 Wishlist [i]Resonant Blade[/i] and get ready for launch coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][i]normal mode difficulty[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/281a599d01e290f2049078975c01f7827ba2b061.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]hard mode difficulty[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/96c237785256ac33aa6efe84faa86d2d7a5fdec5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Otto Sonic Chirp[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/7732f22990db38e7ab8d8ed00f13e28ef5fb2373.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Otto Bio-Repair[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/9139c757598c2ef463827538175b8a77e4c006f8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Wield the Sound: The Resonant Tones of Resonant Blade
notes.content:
[b]The battlefield hums with power. Will you resonate or fall silent?[/b]

[i]In Resonant Blade, sound isn’t just something you hear, it’s something you wield. At the heart of the game lies the Resonant Tones, a set of six unique frequencies that shape combat, puzzle-solving, and exploration.[/i]

[h3][b]Tune In, Strike Hard[/b][/h3]
Atlas begins with three Tones, with the other three earned by taking down dungeon bosses. Each vibrates at a unique frequency, from the deep pulse of Red to the sharp trill of Magenta. Enemies, structures, and the environment all resonate with these Tones. By tuning the Resonant Blade to match their frequency, Atlas can cut through defenses, trigger hidden mechanisms, and uncover secrets buried in the world.

But Resonance isn’t just about combat. Scattered across Terra are Resonant Orbs, ancient switches, and hidden pathways all waiting for the right frequency to bring them to life. To see and hear these vibrations, Atlas uses the Resonance Scanner, highlighting objects in range with a color-coded aura and an audible cue. Some puzzles even require listening carefully to catch the right tone.

[h3][b]Unleash Triads - Sonic Finishing Moves[/b][/h3]
Beyond matching tones, Atlas can harness their power through Triads, special abilities fueled by charged resonance energy. To activate a Triad, Atlas must gather three Charges—earned by parrying attacks or striking enemies with the right Tone. Different combinations trigger different attacks. For example, storing Red + Yellow + Blue unlocks [i]Wave Blade[/i], a cutting shockwave that rips through enemies. Each Triad has its own Resonance, so choosing the right one before attacking is key. With 12 Triads to unlock, six are tied to story progression, while the other six can be bought from Node47, a weapons engineer who deals in sound-based tech. In Resonant Blade, every fight is a song, every puzzle a harmony waiting to be struck. Tune in, match frequencies, and wield the power of sound itself.


[b]WAVE BLADE[/b] [color=red]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
[i]Launches a horizontal sonic wave that pierces through enemies.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/9595fe3f1c2346af0cb1d8999652f0e27b2f9acf.gif[/img]

[b]SONIC SLAM[/b] [color=orange]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
[i]Slam the ground with a resonant shockwave, damaging and knocking back enemies in a wide radius.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/807bee76bb4cd269f63147695edc658c3420edcf.gif[/img]

[b]TIME STRETCH[/b] [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color]
[i]Generate a resonant field that slows enemies and projectiles.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/01f066c03d5cbe1b83d8485633207348358a8eb6.gif[/img]

[b]CYMATIC HEAL[/b] [color=red]◉[/color] [color=orange]◉[/color] [color=yellow]◉[/color] [color=lime]◉[/color] [color=cyan]◉[/color] [color=magenta]◉[/color] [i](3x any color)[/i]
[i]Convert sound into vitality, restoring 25 HP.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42743809/3bc6ccf2fe1e9872bd1c67cb74bf65f39e30026a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]More Resonant Combos Await[/b][/h3]
With 12 Triads in total, we’ve only scratched the surface. Will you discover the hidden combo that unleashes [i]Echo Slice[/i] or the rare defensive power of [i]Harmony Shield[/i]?

notes.title: Official Trailer: Slay Synthwaves in Sci-Fi Action Adventure Resonant Blade!
notes.content:
Check out the new trailer for [url=www.resonantblade.com] Resonant Blade[/url], a 2d sci-fi action-adventure game where you harness the power of sound to fight an army of rogue AI Synths!

[previewyoutube=ETEBUhYugnI;full][/previewyoutube]
In Resonant Blade, take on the role of Atlas, an ex-scientist turned soldier, who takes up arms to fight after his family and hometown were destroyed by the Dark Synths. Using the power of the Resonant Blade, Atlas is able to modulate its sonic energy in order to bypass the Dark Synths’ defenses. From adapting your Resonant Tones to exploiting enemy weaknesses and syncing them for devastating attacks, your ability to listen and adapt is crucial in order to survive. Prepare to dash, parry and modulate in the battle for humanity as every fight is a symphony of strategy in Resonant Blade.
